name: Tryvium Desk
description_en:
Tryvium now presents an enterprise experience-orchestration platform coordinating AI agents,human teams,workflows and business systems across customer and employee service. The assigned record retains its slug,but this research describes the current public platform rather than assuming that an older Tryvium Desk package has identical present entitlements. AWS,Microsoft Azure and GCP are offered as distinct cloud options.

An illustrative employee request would be interpreted against approved knowledge,routed to a system or human approval,executed through authorized integrations,and checked for a confirmed result. The website’s promise of continuous AI-led handling does not establish the API permissions,transaction guarantees or failure recovery for that workflow. No cloud deployment,Teams app,Amazon Connect instance,agent action,connector,AI evaluation,payment or export was executed.
description_zh:
Tryvium当前定位企业体验编排平台，在客户和员工服务中协调AI Agent、人工团队、流程及业务系统。本记录保留原slug，但研究描述当前公开平台，不假设旧Tryvium Desk套餐权益完全相同。AWS、Microsoft Azure及GCP是不同云选项。

假设员工请求需按已批准知识解释，转系统或人工批准，通过授权集成执行，再检查确认结果。网页持续AI处理承诺不建立该流程的API权限、事务保证或失败恢复。未执行云部署、Teams应用、Amazon Connect实例、Agent动作、连接器、AI评估、付款或导出。

core_features.explanation_en: Coordinate intent,systems,workflow context and human judgment across customer or employee requests.
core_features.explanation_zh: 跨客户或员工请求协调意图、系统、流程上下文及人工判断。

core_features.explanation_en: Use AWS/Amazon Connect with prebuilt IVRs,contact flows and service integrations as a selected implementation.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按选定实施使用AWS／Amazon Connect、预建IVR、联系流程及服务集成。

core_features.explanation_en: Azure offering uses Teams to connect employee/customer service,AI agents,workflows and human experts.
core_features.explanation_zh: Azure方案用Teams连接员工／客户服务、AI Agent、流程及人工专家。

core_features.explanation_en: Vendor describes approval workflows,roles,audit trails and visibility around critical AI execution.
core_features.explanation_zh: 厂商描述关键AI执行的批准流程、角色、审计轨迹及可见性。

en: An enterprise evaluating an employee helpdesk with system access controls and human approval for sensitive actions.
A customer-service modernization team selecting one cloud/contact-centre implementation rather than assuming cross-cloud feature parity.
zh: 评估带系统权限及敏感动作人工批准的员工帮助台企业。
选择具体云／联络中心实施，而非假设跨云功能一致的客户服务升级团队。
use_cases.basis: Editorial fit,not verified deployment speed,resolution,accuracy or productivity.

Cloud-specific architecture.en: AWS page identifies Amazon Connect and AWS AI;Azure page identifies Microsoft Teams. GCP is offered,but detailed GCP architecture and cross-cloud portability were not established by the reviewed material.
Cloud-specific architecture.zh: AWS页点名Amazon Connect及AWS AI，Azure页点名Microsoft Teams；虽提供GCP，但已读材料未建立其详细架构或跨云可携性。

steps.en: Choose a single service use case and cloud option;identify systems of record,knowledge sources,permissions and human approvers.
steps.zh: 选择单一服务场景和云选项，明确权威系统、知识源、权限及人工批准者。

steps.en: Confirm actual deployment,cloud/model/telephony dependencies and consumption units in a written scope before provisioning.
steps.zh: 开通前在书面范围确认真实部署、云／模型／电话依赖及消耗单位。

steps.en: Pilot denied permission,missing knowledge,failed action and unavailable approver;verify the final system state and audit/export path.
steps.zh: 试跑拒权限、缺知识、动作失败和批准人不可用，验证最终系统状态及审计／导出路径。

items.en: One-click deployment and no-third-party-dependencies wording does not remove the explicitly named Amazon Connect/AWS service dependencies.
items.zh: 一键部署及无第三方依赖措辞不消除明确点名的Amazon Connect／AWS依赖。

items.en: Persistent context does not establish correct customer identity matching,unlimited retention or portable export.
items.zh: 持续上下文不建立正确客户身份匹配、无限留存或可携导出。

items.en: Governance and certification statements were not checked against configured roles,independent certificates or an executed AI evaluation.
items.zh: 治理及认证表述未按真实角色、独立证书或AI评估验证。

items.en: Pay-as-you-use is stated for AWS,but no unit,amount,currency,minimum,trial or full cloud/AI/telephony cost was established.
items.zh: AWS写按用量，但未建立单位、金额、币种、最低量、试用或完整云／AI／电话成本。

items.en: Website disclaimer does not establish software license,cancellation,refund,retention/deletion or product SLA rights.
items.zh: 网站免责声明不建立软件许可、取消、退款、留存／删除或产品SLA权。

pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Tryvium for AWS明确写按用量／随需求消耗模型，未建立金额、币种、计量单位、最低量、许可承诺、试用／免费、退款或续费。不能由AWS推Azure／Teams及GCP价，底层云／AI／电话／实施成本需另定义。

faq.question_en: Is Tryvium only a Microsoft Teams contact centre?
faq.answer_en: The Azure offering is built on Teams,but the current platform also markets Amazon Connect/AWS and GCP options. Their implementation and entitlement parity was not verified.
faq.answer_zh: Azure方案基于Teams，但当前平台也提供Amazon Connect／AWS及GCP选项，实施及权益一致性未核。

faq.question_en: Does AI orchestration prove that a requested change completed?
faq.question_zh: AI编排证明请求修改已完成吗？
faq.answer_en: No. The platform describes coordinating actions and approvals,but connector success,transaction state and audit confirmation must be checked in the actual system. No workflow was executed.
faq.answer_zh: 不是。平台描述协调动作和批准，但需在真实系统核对连接器成功、事务状态及审计确认，未执行流程。

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent reliability, usability or customer-outcome verification.
English and Chinese are paired drafts. Chinese text does not establish Chinese UI support.
All alternative relationships remain unreviewed. Public-web retrieval may use cached content; prices are dated observations.

sections.title_en: Evaluate the current orchestration platform without inventing a legacy mapping
sections.title_zh: 评估当前编排平台，不编造旧套餐映射
sections.en:
The current Tryvium site emphasizes experience orchestration across customer experience and employee service. It coordinates AI agents,human experts,enterprise applications and workflows rather than describing only an agent phone desktop. This record preserves its original slug,but does not assume that an older Tryvium Desk name has identical current features,pricing or migration rights.

The published stages are understand the interaction,determine the appropriate participant,orchestrate operations,maintain context,govern and measure. For an illustrative IT request,those stages could connect a knowledge answer,approval and system update. They are a product description,not proof that an account change,booking or refund completed correctly. Scope one service and its system of record before adopting broad promises of autonomous resolution.
sections.zh:
当前Tryvium网站强调客户体验及员工服务编排，协调AI Agent、人工专家、企业应用和流程，不只描述客服电话桌面。本记录保留原slug，但不假设旧Tryvium Desk名称与当前功能、价格或迁移权完全一致。

公开阶段是理解互动、决定参与方、编排作业、保留上下文、治理及衡量。假设IT请求可衔接知识回答、批准和系统更新，但这些是产品描述，不证明账户修改、预约或退款正确完成。采用自主解决宽泛承诺前，需界定一个服务及权威系统。

sections.title_en: Amazon Connect is an explicit dependency of the AWS path
sections.en:
Tryvium for AWS identifies Amazon Connect,AWS AI services,prebuilt contact flows,IVRs and service integrations. It describes one-click deployment and IVR migration. Those claims do not remove cloud-account permissions,number/carrier setup,knowledge preparation,model configuration or operational ownership. The phrase without third-party dependencies should not be read as independence from the named AWS services.

An illustrative pilot should confirm who owns the AWS account,which region processes audio and records,what IAM permissions a connector receives and how failed actions are recorded. No deployment template,instance,API protocol or recovery procedure was executed or examined in enough detail to establish production readiness. The pay-as-you-use claim describes a commercial model,not a complete cloud/AI rate schedule.
sections.zh:
Tryvium for AWS明确点名Amazon Connect、AWS AI、预建联系流程、IVR及服务集成，描述一键部署和IVR迁移。这不消除云账户权限、号码／运营商、知识准备、模型配置及运营责任，无第三方依赖措辞不能理解为独立于已点名AWS服务。

假设试点需确认AWS账户归谁、音频和记录在哪处理、连接器获哪些IAM权限，以及失败动作如何记录。未执行或充分审阅部署模板、实例、API协议或恢复流程以建立生产就绪。按用量只描述商业模型，不是完整云／AI费率表。

sections.title_en: Teams-based service and other cloud options need separate scopes
sections.title_zh: Teams服务及其他云选项需分别界定
sections.en:
The Microsoft Azure offering is described as built on Microsoft Teams,connecting employee helpdesk and customer-service workflows with AI/human participation. The homepage also offers GCP. That does not prove identical channels,connectors,recording behavior or commercial units across AWS,Azure and GCP. Microsoft validation/certification statements were read as vendor claims;no independent registry or tenant installation was checked.

For an illustrative employee helpdesk,define identity,knowledge access,who can approve a software request and what system confirms provisioning. Teams familiarity does not grant every user access to HR,ITSM or customer data. Existing cloud licenses,telephony,connector permissions and data-processing locations remain part of the selected implementation. No Teams app or cloud account was connected.
sections.zh:
Microsoft Azure方案描述基于Teams，将员工帮助台及客户服务流程与AI／人工连接，主页还提供GCP。这不证明AWS、Azure、GCP渠道、连接器、录音行为或计费单位一致。Microsoft验证／认证表述仅作为厂商主张，未查独立登记或装租户。

假设员工帮助台需定义身份、知识访问、软件申请批准者及哪个系统确认开通。熟悉Teams不授予每用户HR、ITSM或客户资料访问。既有云许可、电话、连接器权限及处理地点仍属所选实施范围，未连接Teams应用或云账户。

sections.title_en: Human governance must control actions as well as answers
sections.title_zh: 人工治理需控制动作，也需控制回答
sections.en:
The platform and AWS pages describe human approval workflows,role-based controls,audit trails,policy enforcement and ongoing measurement. They also promise continuous context and AI handling with human expertise when needed. These descriptions do not establish that an unauthorized action is blocked,that a failed write is retried safely or that an unavailable approver has a defined fallback.

Use a narrow pilot to test wrong intent,stale knowledge,denied permissions,duplicate requests,an interrupted connector and missing human coverage. Compare the final source-system state with the conversational summary;an AI statement that a request is resolved is not confirmation. Persistent context also needs identity matching,retention and access rules. No AI accuracy,latency,security isolation or autonomous-execution outcome was measured here.
sections.zh:
平台及AWS页描述人工批准、角色、审计轨迹、政策执行和持续衡量，并承诺持续上下文及必要时结合人工。这不建立未授权动作会被拦、写入失败能安全重试，或批准人不可用有明确兜底。

应小范围试跑错意图、旧知识、拒权限、重复请求、连接器中断和人工缺班，比较最终权威系统状态与会话摘要。AI说已解决不是确认，持续上下文还需身份匹配、留存及访问规则。未衡量AI准确率、延迟、安全隔离或自主执行结果。

sections.title_en: Consumption pricing is verified only at the model level
sections.en:
The AWS page explicitly describes a pay-as-you-use consumption model scaling with demand. It publishes no usable amount,currency,billable unit,minimum,trial or renewal/refund conditions in the reviewed text. Do not normalize a monthly seat price or apply the AWS model to Azure/Teams and GCP by assumption. Separate Tryvium fees from underlying cloud,model,telephony,implementation and integration charges in an actual proposal.

The site disclaimer identifies informational content and Sensiple ownership,but is not the product license or service agreement. Software rights,cancellation,data export,deletion,retention,processors and SLA remain unverified. Tryvium is an editorial candidate for an enterprise able to own integration design,human governance and cloud operations. It is not yet evidence of instant deployment,uniform cross-cloud entitlements or a self-service free platform.
sections.zh:
AWS页明确描述随需求增长的按用量模型，但已读文字无可用金额、币种、单位、最低量、试用或续约／退款条件，不能归一化每月席位价或假设Azure／Teams及GCP相同。真实提案需分开Tryvium、底层云、模型、电话、实施及集成费。

网站免责声明说明信息内容及Sensiple所有权，不是产品许可或服务协议，软件权、取消、导出、删除、留存、处理方及SLA仍未核。编辑判断适合能负责集成设计、人工治理及云运营的企业，尚不证明即时部署、跨云统一权益或自助免费平台。
